notes_for_editor: Thin record. The NHLR detail page is the only substantive source; the FFLA list adds the standing status and the (Manzanita) name. The westlookouts.weebly.com Isleta page in the record has only the name in its index and no tower detail, so it is not cited. The access level 'restricted' is inferred from the NHLR location on reservation land, not from a published rule; no visiting information was found. height_m 15.2 converts the register's 50-foot tower height and may not equal the cab-floor height. The agency name is as the NHLR gives it and was not checked against current federal or tribal records. Not verified: current condition, and whether the cab is still used. The NHLR's 2012 photo credit (Jack Shiver) is already in the record, so no new photos were added.
